_metadata.description: Flow discovery: every flow/flow.json in the monorepo is enumerable via flow-verifier CLI and HTTP.

requirements.title: CLI lists every flow/flow.json under a root
requirements.description: flow-verifier flows list --root <repo> enumerates every flow.json schema-v6 contract under the given root.

validation.notes: Go test in cli/domains/flows asserts list output for a synthetic root with multiple flow.json files.

requirements.title: HTTP API exposes the same flow inventory
requirements.description: GET /api/v1/flows?root=<path> returns the same list, with id/path/language/schemaVersion.
